newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo bank issues American Express cards-agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo bank issues American Express cards-agency.

text.p: Yugoslav bank Komercijalna banka a.d. will start issuing American Express Co cards on Tuesday, Tanjug news agency quoted a bank statement a saying.

Yugoslavs will be able to use the international American Express cards in the country and abroad after a five-year interruption due to international war-related sanctions imposed against the country in 1992.

Komercijalna banka a.d. has concluded an agreement with the American Express company European service under which it started issuing American express travellers cheques and nostro cheques earlier this year.
Komercijalna banka provides guarantees for the clients' credit-worthiness. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 43 05
